# Fixture provenance

`item-provenance.json` records the origin, capture status, known build/API version,
dates, sanitization and SHA-256 of each item response fixture.

The four legacy item fixtures first entered the repository on 2026-08-15. That
repository date is not a capture date. Their original capture/build records are
unavailable, so they provide deterministic shape tests and carry no claim of
live-server equivalence. `item-extra-fields.json` is explicitly synthetic.

`item-live-sanitized.json` was captured through the real loopback Local API.
Its record identifies the answering build, original response digest and the
exact classes of sanitized data. Raw personal-library content stays outside
this repository. The normalization spec verifies its actual decoded fields.

`scholarly-save-receipts.json` is generated by the real host tool pipeline over
controlled write outcomes. `scholarly-save-receipt-capture.spec.ts` recomputes and
compares every content/meta value; the browser lane replays this same JSON.
It contains no live Zotero write output. Refresh it only through that capture
spec with `DSH_CAPTURE_SCHOLARLY_RECEIPTS=1`.

Semantic measurement provenance is recorded beside its datasets and archived
vectors in `semantic-admission/model-profiles-report.json`; synthetic calibration
self-checks are labeled separately from real-model measurements.
